title: Heart Crystal
description: This mod add heart crystal that increase you health when mining it
body:
> This mod adds a new ore called **Heart Crystal**. It can be found in **any biome** within the stone layer. Heart Crystals are quite rare and generate in **veins of 1 to 3** blocks. Mining a Heart Crystal permanently **increases your maximum health by 1 heart**. Once you reach 20 hearts, you can no longer mine Heart Crystals.
